4-Vedder light tuck Glock 4" with TLR7. Modified for optic cut, added wing. $45

6-Galco hot rod for CZ P01 models, probably other 75 series as well $30

8-Tagua Glock owb, new $30

9- Galco Glock iwb clip on, new $30

10- texas holsters hybrid owb, you can add iwb clips as well, but I lost them $25
